fresh_diagnostic_usage: Previously inspected development outcomes; never used for fitting, normalization, hyperparameter selection or an independent-test claim
deployment_future: Selected actual-future ranker applied unchanged to predicted futures
normalization: Original eligible training candidate rows only, standard deviation floor 0.05, clipped standardized features [-10,10]; fit once per input family
pairs: Every unordered within-state pair with both candidates prefix-eligible; ties retained; no candidate or repeat is an independent episode
target: Mean matched-continuation signed binary success difference y_i-y_j; one repeat for original source, three for fresh diagnostic
logistic_target: 0.5 + 0.5*mean(y_i-y_j), meaning success preference with half credit for ties
weights: Equal total weight per episode, equal weight per included state within episode, equal weight per included unordered pair within state
selection: Minimum validation episode-weighted squared error of predicted signed success difference across eligible eight-candidate pairs; include zero-utility and previously frozen linear absolute-value controls. Break numerical ties within 1e-9 by zero model, frozen model, linear, fixed tanh, then stronger L2
selection_populations: All collected decisions and separate prefix-eligible subset; no outcome-derived eligibility in deployment
primary_reporting: Episode-weighted pair error, informative-pair ordering accuracy, selected success/gain/help/harm/regret, informative episode coverage, both nested banks four/eight
limits: Utilities/preference scores are not calibrated continuation success probabilities; this is a scoring diagnostic, not a novel method, final test, trained benefit gate or closed-loop controller
cloud: Local CPU only; no VM starts, new resource allocation or collection in this study
